# Crosscut

> Crosscut is a free iOS movie trivia game where each square of a 3x3 grid is the crossing of two film clues.

Crosscut works offline, has no account, no ads and no in-app purchases. Modes: Classic Duel, Reverse Frame, Cinephile Concept. A shared Daily Reel puzzle appears every UTC day (one attempt). Available in English and Turkish.

- [Privacy](https://cine-tactico.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Support](https://cine-tactico.vercel.app/support)
